regime_definition.volatility: current trailing 24h realized volatility <= point-in-time median of trailing 24h vol estimates over the previous 168h

methodology_amendment_before_confirmator.reason: Preserve original calendar dependence instead of bootstrapping an irregularly filtered regime-only sequence.
changes: Use calendar-preserving moving-block bootstrap on the full chronological walk-forward sequence with the regime indicator resampled inside each block.
Treat 2023 as the primary confirmatory period and 2025 as replication rather than testing two co-primary periods.

acceptance_rule.primary_requirement: 95% CI lower bound of paired loss improvement > 0

robustness_checks_after_primary_decision.note: These are sensitivity checks only and cannot rescue a failed primary 7-day-block test.

failure_rule.if_primary_confirmatory_test_fails: retire range_mean_6h as an active 12h candidate
